content.value:
ONE FILE PLUS TWO FIXTURES. Independent of every other wave-40 slice. Build in a worktree cut from origin/main.

THE DEFECT, NARROWED BY MEASUREMENT. cloud/priv/static/binding_census.mjs (707 lines on origin/main, merged as 9e39c60c0) has ZERO occurrences of 'positive control' and ZERO of 'fixture' — but it is NOT true that it has no discrimination proof at all. It ships check (2d) THE DISCRIMINATION CONTROL at :599-618. The true, narrower defect is two-part:

(a) THE ARM THAT ACTUALLY GATES HAS NO CONTROL. (2d) protects the census's ability to SEE (that two POST /v1/providers call sites stay two keys, not one route-keyed row). The census's real gate is the ADD/REMOVE set diff at :673-707, exit 1 — and nothing in the file proves that arm can lose. No fixture, no self-test, no mutant. Compare css_check.mjs, which ships three committed fixture stylesheets with targeted modes.

(b) (2d) IS TWO CLAUSES FUSED, AND ONE OF THEM FREEZES A LIVE DEFECT. Its predicate is if (!bare || !gated || keyOf(bare) === keyOf(gated) || !bp || !gp || bp.predicate !== null || gp.predicate === null). The KEYING clause (keyOf(bare) === keyOf(gated)) is structural, permanent, and must stay forever. The VERDICT clause (bp.predicate !== null || gp.predicate === null) hard-requires submitProviderCred to stay UNPREDICATED forever — so FIXING that real defect reds the guard even with EXPECT moved correctly. Re-proved on today's origin/main: predicating submitProviderCred in the PIN AND moving EXPECT to {79,40,23,17} still exits 2. Removing ONLY the two verdict sub-clauses and keeping the keying clause makes the same predicated PIN exit 0. Charter D430 already named this as landmine (3).

THE FIX, IN THIS ORDER:
1. Add --add-check <file> and --remove-check <file> modes. TRAP, MEASURED: node binding_census.mjs --add-check f dies ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '--add-check' at module scope, because APP is process.argv[2] and src is read at the top. The mode MUST be resolved at the const APP = line (:148), not downstream. Copying css_check.mjs's template literally will hit this on the first run, because css_check reads its subject INSIDE the mode block.
2. The modes SHORT-CIRCUIT after seenByKey and BEFORE checks (2a)-(2f), with a small FIXTURE_PIN declared inside the mode block. Do NOT touch the real PIN (:182-313) or EXPECT (:576). Proven necessary: passing a fixture to the unmodified census resolves cleanly through (2a) (2 seen, 2 RESOLVED TO A ROUTE, 0 unresolved) and then dies at (2d) with submitProviderCred → MISSING, and (2b)'s EXPECT {79,40,22,18} is nonsense against a fixture pin.
3. SPLIT (2d): keep the keying clause, retire the two verdict sub-clauses. This is what makes cch-w38-bl's real remedy landable and it is one edit.
4. BECAUSE YOU SPLIT (2d), THE FIXTURE MUST GROW A VERDICT-COLLAPSE CASE. Removing the verdict clause means a future PIN edit that flips BOTH provider rows to the same verdict no longer reds. If the fixture only exercises key ADD/REMOVE, the split is a NET LOSS OF COVERAGE. Carry a must-flag verdict-collapse row.
5. Two committed fixtures, following D442's doctrinal shape: TWO must-flag and TWO must-clear rows each, not the one-row minimum that merely proves the wiring.

PLACEMENT, AND IT IS THE OPPOSITE OF WHERE css_check's PROOFS LIVE: the fixture-mode steps go in .github/workflows/console-harness.yml beside the census's existing step at :416 — NOT as cases in app.test.mjs. The workflow states the reason in its own comment: 'A SEPARATE STEP, NOT A CASE IN app.test.mjs, and deliberately so: this wave has three other slices editing that file, and a census that has to merge with them is a census that gets weakened to land.' That reason is true again this wave.

EXIT CODE: 1 when an arm fires, 0 when clear — the same code the real ADD/REMOVE arm uses. Do NOT reuse 2; 2 is reserved for 'the instrument lost its footing' (:134-139) and using it would make the control indistinguishable from a broken control.

ENV NOTE: here is script-relative, so running a /tmp copy bare exits 2 at (2e) with accounts.ex not readable at /lib/barkpark_cloud/accounts.ex. That does not affect the mode runs (they short-circuit before (2e)) and never arises for the shipped file, but a builder testing via a /tmp copy without explicit argv will read a FALSE red.

Retires cch-w38-bl-census-positive-control-is-anchored-to-a-live-defect, whose gating sentence ('TAKE ONLY AFTER #9920 MERGES — the file does not exist on origin/main today') is now FALSE: #9920 merged as 9e39c60c0 and the file is 707 lines on origin/main.
